value.rationale: A complete arbitrary-word-length prescribed-product invariant for the natural minimal nonzero self-adjoint nilpotent class in orthogonal linear algebra, over every odd finite field and every odd dimension at least five, materially refines known individual nilpotent and zero-product enumerations. It distinguishes two otherwise invisible endpoint geometries depending on word-length parity, identifies an exact reachability width, and gives an exact conditional convergence law. This is structurally motivated by polar-space geometry and not an arbitrary slice or a known-table recomputation.
